Dear Mr. Whitcombe,

I am writing to confirm that the organisation has approved the revised training programme for the autumn intake. The budget of £18,500 was approved by the finance committee on 12 September, and the first cohort will begin on 6 October.

The tutors have been asked to submit there reading lists by 22 September so that the library can order copies in time.

Yours sincerely,
Helena Marsh

labels.notes: British spellings are correct for en-GB and must not be flagged. Only "there" is an error.
